key_decisions.decision: Preserve the gender-inclusive danger, exception, and exact thirty-day absence; avoid softening the lethal rule.
Retain the plural messengers rather than harmonizing the subject back to Hathach alone.
Preserve the unnamed source of relief and the open question; do not replace either with an explicit divine explanation.
Keep the abstention from both food and drink, the night-and-day duration, and the repeated acceptance of possible death; do not add prayer absent from the Hebrew.
Preserve the reversal in who gives instructions within their relationship.
